messages.subject: Bug report for hBayesDM
parts:
Hi,
 gathered a set of data with attention set shifting (ASST) data, which is the rodent version of the Wisconsin card sorting test. I want to dive deeper into the psychological aspect of this data set, and I came across the hBayesDM package written in R. I think the Bayesian function in the hBayesDM package fits my needs. I want to adapt the wcs_sql.R function to fit ASST data. And rebuild a custom R package. But I found out that the Rstan is preventing the package building process and raised the following error: "Error in rstan::stanc(f, allow_undefined = TRUE, obfuscate_model_name = FALSE): parser failed badly; maybe try installing the V8 package"

I wonder if you have encountered a similar issue before. If so, could you please share how you solved it? I would appreciate your support.

I look forward to hearing from you!

Best regards!
Yueqing

messages.subject: Re: Bug report for hBayesDM
parts:
Hi Yueqing, 

We've noticed the error is usually due to any line including "#" (even in comments) in the stan file. You can replace "#"s with "//" to comment out lines. 

Cheers,
JH

messages.subject: Re: Bug report for hBayesDM
parts:
Hi Yueqing,

More information on (1) what you have done and (2) what you need will be helpful to solve the issue.  Regarding the error message you shared, removing "#"s from all the stan files located within the '/hBayesDM/inst' folder (I guess you are referring to /hBayesDM/commons/stan_files) might have caused the error. If you are trying to use the wcs_sqn model for your own dataset, I suggest you to make edits to the stan file (link) with customized R codes. While doing this, make sure that your (new) stan file doesn't include "#" symbols to prevent the initial error you shared. Let me know if anything is unclear.

Cheers,
JH
